t: This is Christ Church on Brixton Road in Lambeth, an Art Nouveau and Byzantine Revival church, Grade II* listed. Arthur Beresford Pite built it in 1902 for his brother-in-law, Reverend William Mowll. Princess Helena laid the foundation stone in December 1898. That stone was lettered by Edward Johnston and cut by Eric Gill. Look for the prominent clock on the exterior, and the outside pulpit in the south-west corner, which was designed by Weir, Burrows and Weir and dedicated in 1907.
